patterns.note: Asymmetrical section layouts featuring custom line-art illustrations paired with text blocks, often with the illustration occupying more visual space.
Content is consistently centered within a fixed maximum width, providing clear boundaries and readability.
Alternating light background colors (off-white, white, light blue) are used to visually separate major content sections.
Prominent section headings use a dark blue, bold, sans-serif font, while body text is a lighter weight and color, creating a clear typographic hierarchy.
Sections reveal with a subtle fade-in and slight upward slide as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic but smooth scrolling experience.
The primary navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport after initial scroll, maintaining access to key links.

technique_notes: A sticky header navigation bar is implemented, remaining visible and accessible as the user scrolls down the page.

Scroll-triggered animations (likely using css-keyframes as hinted) are applied to content sections, causing them to subtly fade into view and slide up from the bottom as they become visible in the viewport.

The page utilizes custom, minimalist line-art illustrations with subtle color accents, integrated directly into the layout of various content sections to visually explain concepts and add personality.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are significantly larger and bolder than the light-weight body text, with small, uppercase labels used for navigation and sub-elements.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners are applied to buttons and card elements, providing a soft, approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing is used throughout, with slightly more airy vertical separation in hero and major content sections, and a tighter grid for feature cards.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its consistent use of custom, minimalist line-art illustrations. These friendly, approachable drawings are seamlessly integrated into the asymmetrical section layouts, effectively communicating complex financial concepts in a visually engaging and non-intimidating way, setting it apart from typical, often dry, financial services sites.
